Name: General Fund
Description: Pays for day-to-day village services (police, administration, parks, and zoning), mostly from income and property taxes.

Name: Street Construction, Maintenance & Repair
Description: State gasoline tax and vehicle license fees that, by law, may only be spent on streets.

Name: Police
Description: Full-time police department providing 24-hour patrol and Mayor's Court support.

Name: Streets & Service
Description: Street maintenance, snow removal, street lighting, and the village garage.
